title: ChatGPT Expands into Health Sector
description: OpenAI's ChatGPT is making strides in the health sector, becoming widely available and delving into patient health records.

sections.heading: Introduction
paragraphs: ChatGPT, developed by OpenAI, is a language model that has recently been making headlines for its expansion into the health sector.

sections.heading: Health in ChatGPT
paragraphs: According to OpenAI, they have launched a feature called 'Health in ChatGPT', which aims to make the technology more widely available and useful in the health industry.

sections.heading: Moving into Consumer Health
paragraphs: Fierce Healthcare reports that OpenAI is moving deeper into consumer health with the availability of Health in ChatGPT.

sections.heading: Integration with Patient Health Records
paragraphs: AI News highlights that OpenAI is pushing ChatGPT into patient health records, indicating a significant step in the application of AI in healthcare.
